verdict: WSUS client scan failed with 0x80244007. The number of updates the client must pass as prerequisites to `SyncUpdates` exceeds the WSUS web service limit. Typically seen on long-lived servers with many superseded updates.
fix: On the WSUS server, edit `%programfiles%\Update Services\WebServices\ClientWebService\web.config`. Under `<httpRuntime>`, raise `maxRequestLength` to `204800` and add `executionTimeout="7200"`. Under `<appSettings>`, add `<add key="maxInstalledPrerequisites" value="800"/>` and `<add key="maxUpdatesPerRequest" value="200"/>`. Restart IIS. Decline superseded/expired updates via `Invoke-WsusServerCleanup -CleanupObsoleteUpdates -CleanupUnneededContentFiles -DeclineSupersededUpdates -DeclineExpiredUpdates` to shrink the prerequisite graph at the source.
